name: Mondéjar
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A DO in the south of Guadalajara province, around the town of Mondéjar. Allowed grapes include Tempranillo, Syrah, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon for red, and Macabeo, Malvar and Verdejo for white.
